primary_goal: 在不重开 H28 评估语义、H27 成本模型和 H24/H26 存储契约的前提下，检查实际仿真执行链路中可独立测量的 wall time 或峰值内存候选。
method: prepare -> verify -> predict -> score -> review -> promote

baseline.role: H28 promoted evaluation request-coverage contract plus H27/H24/H26 baselines

direction_switch_reason: H28 已收口评估 API 请求覆盖；H25 只关闭 aggregate 报告替换假设，不能代表实际 run_scenario 执行链路已无运行时候选。
recent_directions: H27:计算成本模型物理守恒
H28:预测/评估请求覆盖契约

scope.candidate: 待独立扫描 run_scenario、调度、报告保留、缓存和输入规模的真实执行链路
include: peak resident memory where independently measurable
batch size and request count controls

problem_domain_closure.rule: 同一运行时根因直接影响的执行、报告保留、序列化、缓存和错误路径必须同轮收口；没有可证伪候选保留负结论。

data_roles.development: fresh runtime source scan and controlled local benchmarks
data_roles.holdout: request-count/retention controls not used to tune a multiplier
data_roles.final_acceptance: engineering wall-time/memory evidence only; no Native accuracy

guardrails: 不得把运行时改善称为预测精度改善
不得将 H25 aggregate 负结论扩展到所有执行链路
不得用目标模型端到端耗时反推无解释倍率
保持报告语义和结果等价性
next_step: 完成独立 runtime source scan，登记唯一可证伪候选。
